topics.topic: Ownership and scope of runtime-setting validation for domain-invalid A8 values
questions: Does “wrong form” include every value excluded by A8, especially a syntactically valid time-zone string that the time-zone database does not know and a numeric port outside 1–65535, or does another module reject those domain-invalid values?

Does “wrong form” include every value the A8 start-up table disallows—including a whole-number port outside 1–65535, an unknown time-zone name, and an environment value outside the three RuntimeEnvironment members—or who rejects those values before service_start can succeed?
Which module and capability reject values that have the right form but violate A8, particularly a whole-number port outside 1–65535 or a string naming an unknown time zone?

quotes: | A8 | reading each run setting, its default, and the refusal of a missing required setting or of a value of the wrong form | `runtime_settings` |
| A8 | the refusal of a well-formed port above 65535 and of a time zone the database does not know | `deliverer_service` |
judgement.why: The module ownership table assigns malformed values to runtime_settings and well-formed but domain-invalid ports and unknown time zones to deliverer_service.

topics.topic: Whether absent optional settings use A8 defaults or cause startup failure
questions: Does an absent optional setting take its A8 default, or does every absent setting end the start?

quotes:
A required setting that
is absent ends the start, and an optional one that is absent takes its default.

A connections file that condition 1 of A5 rule 7 rejects, a missing setting, or a token file that A5 rule 2
rejects ends the start.
judgement.why: The flow makes an unqualified missing setting fatal, while A8 says an absent optional setting takes its default.

witness.initial: Every required environment setting is present, but `PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT` is absent.
events: `capability:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings` reads the run settings from the environment.
outcomes: The absent optional port takes its default of 8850 and startup continues.
The missing port setting ends startup before the service listens.
basis: 1. The deployment launches `capability:deliverer_service.run_service`, which owns the remaining steps.
2. `capability:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings` reads the run settings from the environment.
